scenarios.name: blood-moon-urborg
scenarios.why: Blood Moon's type change (layer 4) makes Urborg a Mountain and removes its ability first by dependency, so no land is a Swamp.
scenarios.known_bug: CR 613.8 layer-4 dependency not modelled: rules/chars/types.go:118 walks LType effects in pure timestamp order, so Urborg's Swamp grant still applies after Blood Moon removed Urborg's ability (Urborg and Plains both read Swamp).

scenarios.name: urborg-animate-land-then-ovinize
scenarios.why: Ovinize removes abilities (layer 6) and sets 0/1 (7b) after Animate Land's 3/3 (7b, earlier timestamp); Urborg keeps the Swamp type it gave itself in layer 4.

scenarios.name: opalescence-enchanted-evening-lands-die
scenarios.why: Opalescence depends on Enchanted Evening (it changes what Opalescence applies to), so every permanent becomes an X/X creature; mana-value-0 lands are 0/0 and die.
scenarios.known_bug: SetPower$/SetToughness$ AffectedX is anchored on the static's SOURCE: rules/chars/derive.go:127 and :133 pass ce.Source to StaticAmount (the SubModify arm at :155-:165 honours AddPowerAffected; the SubSet arm has no equivalent), so every Opalescence creature gets Opalescence's own MV 4 (lands 4/4 survive).

scenarios.name: humility-march-lattice-lands-die
scenarios.why: Lattice makes every permanent an artifact (layer 4), March makes noncreature artifacts creatures with P/T equal to mana value (7b, later timestamp than Humility's 1/1), so the mana-value-0 lands are 0/0 and die. Only the land assertion is ported: XMage additionally asserts that Humility, March and Lattice die, which this port does not adopt without a ruling (by CR 613.7 timestamps they would be 4/4, 4/4 and 6/6).
scenarios.known_bug: CR 613.8 layer-4 dependency not modelled (rules/chars/types.go:118 timestamp-only walk): March of the Machines (earlier timestamp) is not reapplied after Mycosynth Lattice makes the lands artifacts, so lands are noncreature artifacts and survive; with the walk fixed the AffectedX source-anchor bug (rules/chars/derive.go:127) would still make them 4/4.

scenarios.name: humility-masumaro
scenarios.why: Masumaro's P/T CDA applies in 7a; Humility's set-to-1/1 in 7b overrides it.

scenarios.name: conspiracy-opalescence-evening
scenarios.why: Enchanted Evening makes all permanents enchantments, Opalescence (depends on it) makes them creatures, Conspiracy (depends on Opalescence) gives the chosen creature type -- even to lands; Glorious Anthem keeps MV-0 lands alive as 1/1s.
scenarios.known_bug: Both layer bugs: CR 613.8 layer-4 dependency (rules/chars/types.go:118; Conspiracy is applied before Opalescence/Enchanted Evening make the permanents creatures, so nothing becomes an Advisor) and the AffectedX source anchor (rules/chars/derive.go:127; Swamp 4/4 instead of 0/0+anthem).

scenarios.name: control-opalescence-alone
scenarios.why: Control: Opalescence alone makes each OTHER non-Aura enchantment a creature with base P/T equal to ITS OWN mana value: Glorious Anthem (MV 3) is 3/3, +1/+1 from itself = 4/4.
scenarios.known_bug: Same root cause as opalescence-enchanted-evening-lands-die: rules/chars/derive.go:127/:133 anchor AffectedX on the source (Glorious Anthem reads 5/5 = Opalescence's MV 4 + anthem, want 4/4).
